notes: Unit economics base = standalone AR abridged P&L (Rs mn) / total units (domestic + exports incl. sales to Toyota). FY25-FY26 = AR FY26 figures RESTATED for SMG amalgamation (appointed date 1-Apr-2025): Gujarat plant economics now in-house, so EBITDA/vehicle and D&A step up. FY18-FY24: Gujarat cars bought from SMG at cost under the CMA, so SMG depreciation and royalty sat inside RM cost.

realisationPerVehicle = net sales (vehicles + spares/components) / units. vehicleRevenuePerUnit = 'Vehicles' revenue line / units; FY15-FY17 vehicle line is GROSS of excise and FY18 includes Q1 excise, so not comparable with FY19+.
EBITDA = net sales + other operating revenue (+ sale of services FY25-26) - RM - employee - other expenses; EBIT = EBITDA - D&A. Derived; FY15-FY16 IGAAP, FY17+ Ind AS.

discountPerVehicle (annual) = 'Discount & incentives as per contract/scheme bulletins' deducted from gross contract price (Ind AS 115 revenue reconciliation note) / total units. Includes dealer incentives; broader than the consumer-discount figure quoted on calls. Not disclosed pre-FY18. Call/broker quarterly points in discountHistoryCalls.

royaltyPct = P&L royalty / standalone net sales. FY18-FY24 royalty on Gujarat-made cars was paid by SMG to SMC and embedded in MSIL's purchase price, so MSIL P&L royalty understates the group burden (Q3FY20: total 5.4% = MSIL 3.8% + SMG 1.6%, BOBCAPS). FY25-26 (merged) is the all-in basis: 3.47% / 3.09%. FY19 royalty restated to Rs44,983mn in AR FY20 (vs 37,926 as reported) - as-reported used.
R&D = Board's report 'Expenditure incurred on R&D' (capital + net revenue). FY25/FY26 per AR FY26 (3,795+2,083; 3,879+2,884) look narrower in basis than FY24 (9,135) - use with caution.
adPct = 'Advertisement' line / net sales; salesPromoPct = 'Sales promotion' line (excludes discounts netted from revenue).

suzuki.royaltyHistory: Royalty rose from 2.7% of sales (FY08) to ~6% (FY14; Q1FY15 6.2%). Sep-2014: royalty on new models rupee-denominated; co-developed models carry lower royalty; FY18 lower-royalty method from Ignis + volume discount. All-in ~3.1% FY26.
suzuki.toyotaArrangement: 2018 Toyota-Suzuki mutual supply pact: MSIL supplies Baleno->Glanza, Brezza->Urban Cruiser (disc.), Ertiga->Rumion (2023), Fronx->Taisor (2024), e Vitara->Toyota BEV (made by MSIL Gujarat); Toyota supplies Innova Hycross->Invicto; Grand Vitara/Hyryder co-developed, made by Toyota Kirloskar. MSIL 'sales to other OEMs' FY26 113,235 (company.json). Toyota-side rebadged sales FY24 107,151 (43% of Toyota India). Model pairs partly general knowledge.

treasuryNotes: Rs mn; MD&A 'Investment of surplus funds' table (excludes strategic stakes in associates/JVs). treasuryIncome = income from that book; yield = treasury income / average book (derived).
